spec(67-08): admit weekday launches through the owner amendment deadline

Owner instruction 2026-11-03 (verbatim: we're bypassing) waives the D-08 weekend-only compute window for a one-shot weekday extension. A weekday launch is admitted only before 2026-11-04 07:30 America/Chicago; that deadline is also the closing instant require_remaining_window uses, so every registered whole-launch cap must fit entirely before it and no admitted run can outlive it. After the deadline the original weekend window applies unchanged; the AC check, caps and all other refusals are untouched. The harness freeze manifest is re-pinned to the amended diagnostic_power.py bytes and the committed exp02 metadata registration re-pins the new manifest digest; no real attempt has run, so no evidence is invalidated and receipts still record the true launch weekday.

resource_rulings.commit_message:
spec(67-12): admit weekday launches through the owner amendment deadline

Owner instruction 2026-11-06 (verbatim: "continue with amendment. we've reached the weekend and we can feel free to start this work now") authorizes a third one-shot weekday extension, superseding the expired 2026-11-04 amendment. The new deadline 2026-11-07 07:30 America/Chicago is a pure bridge into the weekend window: from Saturday 00:00 the weekend branch admits with the Sunday 22:00 closing regardless, so the deadline governs only pre-midnight Friday launches; every registered whole-launch cap must still fit entirely before the closing instant. The AC check, the caps and all other refusals are untouched. The harness freeze manifest is re-pinned to the amended diagnostic_power.py bytes and the 62 live registrations (the two metadata registrations and the 60 exp02/exp03 timing and science rows) re-pin the new manifest digest and the new power digest; no gated operation has run under the new deadline, so no evidence is invalidated, run records keep their as-captured citations per the ed93f359/179efd80 convention, and receipts still record the true launch weekday. The deadline-referencing tests follow the new geometry: the exact-fit cap boundary is only constructible at the Sunday closing (already covered), so the amendment test now asserts Friday receipts fit with hours of runway to the Saturday closing, and the post-deadline refusals are the following Monday and Tuesday.

Suites at this commit: phase65 204 OK, phase66 101 OK, phase67 245 OK.
